notes.title: Progress Report & Next Steps
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We’ve released an important update for [i]Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation[/i]. As development continues, we’re making a few adjustments to keep the project strong and moving forward.

Today we’re sharing an important message directly from Scarlett Steele’s writer, Tiago R. 
We want you to hear his thoughts in his own words, as this update concerns the creative direction of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What[/b]’[b]s Changing[/b][/p][p]Some scenes and paths are now marked as “[b]Currently Unavailable.”[/b]
This is temporary as these sections are being rewritten and refined to return in improved form with even greater impact.[/p][p]These adjustments are part of aligning the game with [b]Steam[/b]’[b]s content guidelines[/b], which helps us ensure [i]Scarlett Steele [/i]remains available and accessible to all players moving forward.[/p][p]If you’d like to read more details about why these changes are happening, we’ve shared a longer explanation on our Patreon and Boosty pages.
[/p][p][b]Chapters & Content[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Chapter 1[/b] will receive a few re-renders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapter 2[/b] requires deeper revisions, and work on those is ongoing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapter 3[/b] writing is well underway and moving toward the finish line.[/p][/*][/list][p]I'm also refreshing some dialogue and humour to bring in new energy and polish.
[/p][p][b]Achievements[/b][/p][p]To keep 100% completion possible, the following achievements have been [b]temporarily disabled[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Mission Restarted[/p][/*][*][p]Bricks of Fate[/p][/*][*][p]Bunny’s Secret[/p][/*][*][p]The Devil’s Temptation[/p][/*][/list][p]These will return, along with brand new ones, once the revised content is ready.
[/p][p][b]Final Words[/b][/p][p]I know some of these changes may feel unexpected, but they’re part of making [i]Scarlett Steele[/i] stronger and more polished for everyone.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support, it means a lot, and I'm excited to share more with you as writing continues.
[/p][p]– [b]Tiago R.
[/b][i]Scarlett’s Writer[/i][/p]

notes.title: Studio Update… Scarlett & What’s Next
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We want to give you a clear update on [i]Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation[/i] and where the studio is heading.
[/p][p]🔹[b] Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation[/b][/p][p]The writing for the Chapter 2 as well as final chapter is still not finished. Without a complete and polished script, we cannot move into rendering, production, or release. This also means there hasn’t been much to share in terms of meaningful updates, until the script is finalized, there is no foundation to build on. [i]Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation[/i] will only move forward once the full draft is complete and polished to the same standard we set with Chapter 1.[/p][p]Scarlett is therefore paused until the script is delivered in full. This is NOT abandonment, but it is the only way to ensure the quality and integrity of the game remain intact.
[/p][p]🔹[b] The Studio’s Work[/b][/p][p]Although it may have seemed quiet from the outside, this summer was not a break. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to keep the studio alive and refine our vision. At the same time, we’ve prepared a brand-new game that is now ready for production.[/p][p]The scenario is finished, assets are ready, and rendering begins immediately. This project is fully under the studio’s control, which means consistent updates, previews, and real progress you can count on.
[/p][p]🔹[b] Looking Ahead[/b][/p][p][i]Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation [/i]remains on hold until the script is finalized. Updates on that game will only come once the writing is finished and approved for production. In the meantime, you can expect to hear more about our new project very soon, including details, previews, and regular production updates.[/p][p]For those who want to follow the behind-the-scenes story more closely, we’ve shared a deeper reflection with our community outside of Steam. Here, we’ll keep things focused on the essentials.[/p][p][/p][p]We know this has been a long and difficult road, and we understand some of you followed us specifically for Scarlett. We don’t take that lightly. But we believe the only honest path is one of clear boundaries and real results.
[/p][p]Scarlett is paused. The studio is alive. And the new project is proof that we can, and will, move forward.
[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support. Your encouragement is what keeps us going, and from here on, the progress you see will be real.
[/p][p]Best wishes,
[i]VenusVision Studio Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 👍 CHAPTER 1 & 2 REBUILD: Shaping Up Something Special
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Time for another monthly update - and we’re excited to say that things are going really well! Development is progressing steadily, and Chapter 1 is nearly complete. We’re deep in the final stages: polishing animations, fine-tuning pacing, refining atmosphere, and making sure every detail hits just right. It’s shaping up to be something truly special, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

One of our biggest breakthroughs came when we realized that some characters were starting to feel too "robotic" in our revised scenarios. That was our cue to return to the heart of Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation and rebuild some of the characterizations from the ground up. Now, choices feel more dynamic, sexual encounters more intense, and character arcs more emotionally authentic.

As the narrative evolves and characters face new paths - some steamy, some moral, some both - we’ve been working hard to ensure that player perception shifts in meaningful ways. It’s been a rewarding challenge, and the game is stronger for it.

We’re also paying close attention to your feedback and making thoughtful adjustments across the board.
Your support on Patreon has made all of this possible, and we’re endlessly grateful.

[b]🖊️ A Word from the 3D Developer:[/b]

Hello there, Ennushka here...

As the 3D developer of Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation, my personal goal is to constantly raise the bar of quality. I’ve often felt that many games on the market fall short when it comes to truly showcasing emotional weight and storytelling through their visuals. For this project, I’m committed to bringing a more cinematic approach - framing each scene with the care and precision you would expect from a movie.

I know I still have much to learn, and with time, the visuals will only become even better, but the foundation we’re building now is something I’m genuinely proud of. I want the world, the atmosphere, and every character moment to feel alive and meaningful, not just like a series of static shots.

I’m also incredibly happy to see that the feedback so far has been positive, especially regarding the visual side of the game. That positive energy is truly the wind at my back, pushing me to go even further and deliver something exceptional. Knowing that the work resonates with you means more than words can express.

It’s also an absolute joy to work on the more erotic scenes. There’s a real beauty in crafting these moments, not just in terms of sensuality, but in how they reveal character, deepen emotional bonds, and enrich the overall storytelling. Treating these scenes with the same care and artistry as any other moment is part of what makes this project so special to me.

Thank you again for trusting me with this vision.
Right now, I'm showcasing some non-explicit renders, and you can expect a separate Sneak Peek post featuring more explicit renders very soon on Patreon and Boosty!

Kind regards,
VenusVision Studio

notes.title: CHAPTER 1 & 2 REBUILD: Storms, Setbacks, and Perseverance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/f04fac7ccee8a23c6bfcedeb132f5b72a81f9e46.png[/img]

Hello, dear supporters!

This update comes later than expected, and for good reason. Between mid-February and early March, we encountered several setbacks that slowed us down more than anticipated.

One of the biggest challenges was quite literal—a storm caused electrical instability, frying one of our systems. While replacing the motherboard was straightforward, selecting a new GPU was a tough call in today’s market. After much deliberation (and a fair share of frustration), we gathered everything needed to get back on track.

Fortunately, this hardware issue only affected the design side of development. Our writer has been forging ahead uninterrupted, continuing work on Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation.

Despite these delays, we remain on track to complete the Revamp this month, leaving the rest of the year dedicated to finishing the game. Your patience and support mean the world to us, and we can’t thank you enough.

Now, let’s hear from our writer about the progress made over the past months!

[h1]🖊️ [b]A Word from the Writer[/b][/h1]

Hello there!

If you’re reading this, thank you for taking the time to check out our update.

From the very beginning, I knew that writing was just as crucial as visuals in bringing Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptationto life. However, in the early stages, with limited renders, I relied heavily on narration to build immersion. While this created a rich and detailed experience, it also resulted in an overwhelming amount of text.

Your feedback was loud and clear: the writing needed to be more engaging, immersive, and concise. Now that our studio can produce a far greater number of renders and animations, we have the opportunity to refine our storytelling to better align with industry standards—and, most importantly, with your expectations.

So, what’s changing? Let’s dive in:

🔹 [b]Engaging Dialogues[/b]

With revamped scenes, I’ve strengthened the connection between visuals and text. Dialogue has been rewritten, refined, and even expanded, while excessive narration has been cut. The result? More natural, immersive conversations that truly bring the story to life.

🔹 [b]Minimal Narration[/b]

I’ve removed 95% of the narration—yes, you read that right! No more long-winded descriptions of events you can now see unfold on screen. Instead, narration has been trimmed or replaced with character dialogue and Scarlett’s inner thoughts, creating a more cinematic experience.

🔹 [b]More Choices, More Impact[/b]

Who doesn’t love choices? While Chapters 1 and 2 already featured key decisions, we’re taking it even further by introducing more mid-impact choices. These will influence how scenes play out, deepening your connection with Scarlett’s journey while maintaining the major choices that shape the ending.

This is just the beginning of Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation’s evolution. The Revamp will appeal to even more players while bringing fresh excitement to those already on board.

As the game’s writer, please know that your feedback never goes unnoticed. I’m constantly striving to refine every detail to deliver the best experience possible.

Thank you for your support—it truly means everything!

Kind regards,
VenusVision Studio

notes.title: Big News: Animations and a Complete Revamp!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/a0895bbcc8a667f07b5e6f9a2dd04774518ceb06.jpg[/img]

Hello there, dear supporters,

We’re so excited to share this announcement with you, even though it might come as a surprise! While we recently updated you about our progress and plans for Chapter 3, something truly incredible has happened in the past few days, and we couldn’t wait to tell you.

Thanks to the amazing support from all of you—whether through game sales, Patreon, Boosty, or simply being here with us since the beginning—we’ve reached an extraordinary milestone.

We’re also deeply humbled by a generous investment from one remarkable supporter who has chosen to remain anonymous. This act of kindness, combined with your ongoing encouragement, has allowed us to achieve one of our most ambitious goals.

We’re thrilled to announce that we are now [b]able to implement animations[/b] into the game and completely revamp Chapters 1 and 2! This means incorporating many of your suggestions: [b]more choices, forking paths, and updates that will enrich the story and make the experience even more immersive.[/b]

Originally, we planned to focus these enhancements solely on future chapters, leaving Chapters 1 and 2 as they were. However, after thorough discussions and revisiting the incredible feedback you’ve shared over the past two months, we decided it was essential to upgrade the entire game from the beginning.

Your input has always been invaluable, and we want every part of the game to reflect the journey we’ve taken together.

This achievement belongs to all of you. Your belief in us, your financial support, your feedback, and your enthusiasm have brought us to this moment. We are incredibly grateful to have such an amazing community by our side.

Stay tuned as we’ll be sharing [b]more details soon[/b] about these updates, what’s next for our team and the game, and [b]a detailed new roadmap[/b]—without spoilers! We’re beyond excited to embark on this new chapter together.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for believing in us. Let’s keep moving forward and make this journey unforgettable.

With endless gratitude,
VenusVision Studio

Get ready for our Holiday Special coming this December! We’re adding an exciting, contemporary scene that fits perfectly into the story—free for all players who join the adventure starting this month. This bonus content will extend the experience of Chapter 2, adding even more value and playtime.

[b]A Very Special Thanks [/b]

None of this would have been possible without you, our incredible community of early supporters. To those who are ready to jump into Early Access, provide feedback, and help us shape this adventure from its very inception: we see you, we hear you, and we are eternally grateful.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for believing in Scarlett, her story, and in us. This chapter is only the beginning—together, we’re building something truly special.

Best regards,
VenusVision Studio

notes.title: Chapter 2 Update: It's Almost Coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/5dcc68add7fd5a8f1768e1b84720f84cb3ca6e8e.png[/img]

As Albert Camus once said:

[i]"Autumn is a second spring when every leaf is a flower."[/i]

We couldn’t agree more! We wish you a fantastic October and an early Halloween celebration, as we won’t be updating again until November. Whether you’re out trick-or-treating or enjoying some fun and sexy video games, we hope you have an amazing time!

While many are busy carving pumpkins this month, we at VenusVision are busier than ever—in the best way possible.

Before diving into the news, we want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has wishlisted Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation on Steam. If you haven’t added it to your wishlist yet, now’s the perfect time—it would mean the world to us!

Without further ado, let’s dive into this month’s updates.

[b]Steam Next Fest: October Edition[/b]
As mentioned in our last update, Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation will be featured in Steam’s Next Fest tomorrow, where Scarlett will shine alongside many other fantastic upcoming games from studios worldwide! Players will be able to download and try out the new demo, which is already available.

[b]Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation Early Access[/b]
For those who can’t get enough of our favorite spy, Scarlett, we’ve got great news! The game will launch in Early Access during November. Patreon subscribers eligible for Beta Early Access will get to play the content up to six days before it becomes available on Steam.

[b]Chapter 2 Updates[/b]
We know many of you are eagerly awaiting more details on Chapter 2, so we’re thrilled to share some exciting updates—and maybe even a few bonus tidbits!

Although Chapter 2 will be labeled version 0.50, it won’t mark the halfway point of the game’s completion. We have exciting plans for Chapter 3, which is set to be the largest chapter yet, and Chapter 4 will be an explosive conclusion—but we’ll tackle that when the time comes. Let’s take things one step at a time, with steady progress.

[b]What to Expect in Chapter 2[/b]
We know you have many questions, but no spoilers here! What we can promise is that Chapter 2 will build on everything you loved about Chapter 1, with even more to look forward to:

Extended dialogues with humor, teasing, and plenty of surprises, introducing new characters along the way.

Romance scenarios with dynamic choices, offering different paths based on player preferences.

A "bad ending" that leads to a premature Game Over for those who take the wrong path.

New characters with the potential for future romance, depending on your choices.

Hundreds of new renders in stunning 1440p quality.

Plot twists, surprises, and much more!

It’s too soon to speculate on the full future of Scarlett’s journey, but we’ll leave you with some juicy previews of what’s to come. Can you imagine the kind of scenarios that await?

Thank you again for your feedback, suggestions, and continued support. We can’t wait to see you at Steam Next Fest and hear what you think!

Happy Halloween, everyone!

Best regards,
[i]VenusVision Studio[/i]

notes.title: Big News Alert: New Chapter 1, Languages, and Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
News, News, and Even More News!

Hello everyone, and welcome to a very special announcement!

We hope this message finds you well and enjoying the romantic vibes of Autumn. Summer may be over, but Autumn has its own magic—and we’ve got plenty of exciting news to share!

First and foremost, we’re thrilled to unveil our [b]New Demo![/b]

As mentioned in our earlier monthly update, we’ve been hard at work improving the Demo (Chapter 1), which now almost fully encompasses the first chapter of Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation.

The new Demo is now available for download on our official Steam page. But don’t be fooled—this Demo is just a small taste of what’s to come in the final product!

Here’s what’s new in this updated Demo:

[b]New Renders[/b]
We’ve added a brand new set of renders to enhance immersion and provide a smoother experience. We’ve also increased the level of detail across all existing renders. The Demo now features over 60 renders at 1440p resolution, with improved skin and texture details.

[b]New Languages[/b]
We’ve expanded language support to include Italian, Russian, and both European and Brazilian Portuguese. You can select your preferred language in the Options -> Language menu. This is just the beginning, as we’re committed to adding even more languages after Early Access release.

[b]Optimisation[/b]
The Demo is now 200MB smaller, thanks to our switch in format for images. This has significantly reduced file size while maintaining high render quality across a variety of screens and devices.

We’re also excited to announce that Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest: October Edition![/b] 

Starting October 14th, this event will be a fantastic opportunity for us to connect with the adult gaming community, gather new feedback, and continue growing among visual novel enthusiasts.

If you haven’t added our game to your Wishlist yet, now is the perfect time! [b]It will help us immensely in reaching more players.[/b]

In addition to all this great news, we’re unveiling our updated Roadmap. It now includes our past achievements, current projects, and future plans. While predicting the future is never easy, seeing how far we’ve come makes us hopeful for what lies ahead.

We’re still on track to release Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation in Early Access later this year, featuring a robust and captivating Chapter 2 with four times the renders and an outstanding increase in quality.

All of us at VenusVision Studio are thrilled and grateful to have you with us on this journey.

May our adventure together never end. Thank you all for your incredible support!

Stay tuned for the next major update—we can’t wait to hear your feedback!

Best regards,
Ennushka & Tiago
[i]VenusVision Studio[/i]

notes.title: Chapter 2 Update: Major Changes & Revamped Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/1f5a6418b3c2f3cd8ebee8696394ddae53ddb466.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

August may have come to an end, but there's still time to soak in the early September sunshine with your loved ones. We couldn't kick off a monthly update without first expressing our heartfelt gratitude to our incredible supporters. Your ongoing enthusiasm and generosity leave us deeply touched and amazed, especially as Scarlett Steele is still in its early stages of development. Your support truly means the world to us and is opening up new opportunities for us to grow and improve. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts!

For us at VenusVision, August was a month of renewal and progress. We set out to enhance our work, and we’re excited to share all the updates, news, and announcements with you. The next few months are going to be challenging, but we can’t wait to take them on!

[b]Quick Recap[/b]
Last month, we made significant strides in enhancing the renders for Chapter 1, adding several new ones in the process. We’ve also transitioned all renders to the .webp format, which, as expected, cut the demo’s file size in half.

[b]Improvements[/b]
In addition to the renders, we also improved the English script. We saw room for improvement and took action. New dialogue lines have been added, and we addressed several issues that slipped through our initial proofreading. The result is a much more polished experience.

[b]New Languages[/b]
While refining the English script, we decided to expand Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation with additional language support. We are officially adding Portuguese, Italian, and Russian. We're still working on French, but for now, our focus is on these three languages.

[b]Chapter 2 Languages[/b]
We’re also excited to confirm additional language support for Chapter 2. Italian, Portuguese, and Russian will be available.

[b]New Demo Release Date[/b]
Our revamped demo will be released soon, just in time for Steam Next Fest: October 2024 Edition. We’re hopeful that Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation will gather even more wishlists and grow in visibility. As always, the demo will be free to download.

With all these improvements, we’ve brought the quality of Chapter 1 up to the same high standards we’ve set for Chapter 2. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional experience, with a wealth of new renders, dialogue, and plenty of surprises as Agent Scarlett embarks on a life-changing adventure.

None of this would be possible without you. We are deeply thankful for your continued support, dedication, and patronage. Stay tuned for the next major update—we can’t wait to hear your feedback!

Best regards,

notes.title: Chapter 2 Update: Romance Unfolds!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/6982198aa2ff285f1b6845597227727f645cfae8.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We hope you're all having a fantastic summer, surrounded by friends, family, and good vibes. We're excited to bring you another thrilling update on Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation, packed with surprises and mysteries we can't wait to share!

First and foremost, we want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who provided feedback over the past month. Your insights are invaluable and drive us to keep improving and delivering content that resonates with our fans. With that in mind, we have three major announcements:

[b]1. Enhanced Renders in Chapter 1[/b]
We're adding more renders to the first chapter. Given the progress we've made on Chapter 2, it only makes sense to elevate Chapter 1 to the same level of detail and passion. These new renders won’t alter the narrative but will ensure a smoother and more immersive experience.

[b]2. Format Upgrade to .webp[/b]
In response to your feedback, we're transitioning from .png to .webp format for our renders. This change will enhance performance, reduce file sizes, and increase accessibility, all while maintaining compatibility with our engine.

[b]3. Steam Demo Now Supports macOS[/b]
We've updated our Steam Demo to include full macOS support, so our Mac users can now download and enjoy the experience.

Once again, thank you to everyone who shared their feedback and opinions. Your input is always highly valued and appreciated.

[b]Character Introductions: Núbia & Fabio[/b]

In July, we introduced Iris and shared insights into her story and her significant role in Chapter 2. This August, we're excited to introduce two more characters: Núbia, whom many of you will recognize from the Demo, and Fabio, a key figure in Scarlett's journey.

We’re also thrilled to announce that Núbia, Fabio, and Iris will all be potential love interests for Scarlett.

[b]Meet Núbia
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/3466b7055185df53ac4679e5c5d9ce81b61e78c5.png[/img]

Núbia grew up amidst the turmoil of a war-torn region in West Africa, where survival and resilience were daily realities. Despite the chaos, she exhibited remarkable intelligence and curiosity. She joined the military at a young age, driven by a desire to protect those she loved. Núbia's academic and military achievements caught the attention of private institutions, leading her to play a pivotal role in the events of the present day.

[b]Meet Fabio[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/685f8f5abb59df39ca9726619609188103f6585b.png[/img]

Fabio is a passionate reporter dedicated to uncovering the truth. His love for nature and the environment often guides his journalistic pursuits, leading him to stories that highlight both human and natural struggles. Fabio’s journey as a truth-seeker brought him closer to Núbia. United by shared experiences in conflict zones and a common goal of justice, they’ve become close allies. Núbia, aware of an imminent biohazard disaster, confides in Fabio, hoping his report could spark change. However, Fabio never made it out of the facility and remains captured.

You'll soon have the chance to unravel these mysteries yourself in Chapter 2, which will feature three unique sexual encounters, each shaped by your choices.

As always, we remain committed to delivering the high-quality storytelling and content that you've come to expect from us.

Thank you for your continued support and stay tuned for more updates!

Best regards,
Ennushka & Tiago
VenusVision Studio

notes.title: Chapter 2 Update: Exciting Developments Ahead!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/36e9656648ee65eb22085144ca6f31de88ccd88e.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

We hope you're all doing well and staying safe! We're thrilled to bring you an exciting update about Chapter 2 of Scarlett Steele: Viral Temptation. Your support has been incredible, and we're eager to share the latest developments with you.

Chapter 2 will introduce exciting new elements. Firstly, we're adding new characters to shift the narrative focus towards dynamic dialogues, moving away from extensive narration. This change is particularly thrilling.

Secondly, we're incorporating our first wave of sexual content, which will allow us to explore blending text and images in innovative ways we haven't tried before. While our writing process will remain consistent, we’re eager to continue experimenting to create content that resonates with everyone.

While we've already received positive feedback on our render quality, we're committed to continuous improvement. You can anticipate significantly improved quality as our 3D developer has acquired new tools and plans to implement advanced techniques to enhance the player experience. We've also addressed the issues with the number of renders in Chapter 1, ensuring smoother production moving forward.

[b]Introducing Iris[/b]

Iris is a docile and pretty scientist with a passion for the internet. She’s nerdy yet charming and enjoys walking her dog on the beach. A gentle soul who cannot stand unfairness, Iris is deeply troubled by the corruption she sees within the organization. During her internship, she was dedicated and developed a great admiration for Núbia, becoming the only person Núbia can truly show affection to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078711/76c93a6658e1eb3d32881f1f27e69f619c842304.png[/img]

You can expect to be able to tweak Iris's final looks in the upcoming polls. 
((Join our Discord for more information.))

[b]A Glimpse into Chapter 2[/b]

[spoiler] Chapter 2 kicks off with a dramatic scene featuring Iris and an old doctor. Iris witnesses firsthand how the organization is misusing their power for their own gain. She realizes that things are not as they seem, and she begins to see through the organization's facade. The shady dealings she uncovers set the tone for the rest of the chapter.

Iris, partially hidden, observes the organization's corrupt activities with the old doctor. As she processes the shocking truth, she starts questioning everything she once believed in.

The scene then shifts to Scarlett, who is in the shower in Núbia's room. Players will be initially confused about why Scarlett is there, but it soon becomes clear. Scarlett knows Núbia is harmless and needs the gear. The two engage in a silent yet intense battle of wits and words. Núbia eventually reveals the true nature of the chemical weapon, intensifying the conflict between them.

Núbia admits she can't destroy the weapon alone and needs Scarlett's help. She reveals another key player, Fabio, a reporter who knows the truth. Scarlett is torn between trusting Núbia or the agency. Players must decide: trust Núbia and continue the game, or refuse and face dire consequences.
We're holding back many details for you to experience firsthand.[/spoiler]

We're thrilled to bring you these exciting updates that we hope you enjoyed reading about. Stay tuned for more adventures and twists as our story unfolds. Your support means everything to us, and we can't wait to hear your feedback. Until next time, happy gaming!

Best regards,
Ennushka & Tiago
VenusVision Studio
